name: Frontier

evidence.claim: Frontier personnel can earn as much as $10 for each bag a passenger is forced to check at the gate.
evidence.source: US Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations, Majority staff report, 'The Sky's the Limit — The Rise of Junk Fees in American Travel', 26 Nov 2024
evidence.corroboration: PSI: Frontier and Spirit paid $26 million to gate agents and other personnel between 2022 and 2023 to catch passengers allegedly not following airline bag policies, often forcing those passengers to pay a bag fee or miss their flight.
evidence.verified_against: subcommittee press release read in full; the 55-page report itself has NOT been read

allowances.note: Personal item only. Adding a carry-on at the gate is the most expensive way to do it.
Carry-on bundled into the fare, and a notably generous size limit. Adding it later, especially at the gate, is far more expensive.
